entities.name: PMID:10730364
observations: 2000 report titled '[10 year results with a cemented fine-grit-blasted titanium-aluminum-vanadium hip endoprosthesis shaft].'
Reports 95.4% Kaplan–Meier femoral-component survival at 10 years; mean follow-up was 11 years 4 months.
Mean Merle d’Aubigné score improved from 10.5 to 16.0; 18 femoral-component reoperations were reported (2.9%).
Accessible abstract reports a cemented titanium–aluminum–vanadium stem with fine-grit-blasted surface but does not identify a commercial model or explicitly state Ti-6Al-4V.
